props.name: value
props.description: Controlled number in E.164 form, e.g. `+442071838750`. Empty string when blank.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the E.164 string on every edit, and when the country changes.

props.name: countries
props.description: Countries offered in the dial-code select. Defaults to `PHONE_INPUT_COUNTRIES`.

props.name: defaultCountry
props.description: ISO code selected when the value does not name a country.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the number field. Field supplies a visible one through `id`.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder for the national number. Defaults to the country's mask.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the number invalid and reddens the border. Pair with a message.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks interaction and dims the control.

props.name: id
props.description: Put on the number input, so a Field label points at it.

props.name: 'aria-describedby'
props.description: Forwarded to the number input. Field sets it to its hint or error.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name for the E.164 value, submitted through a hidden input.
